figures.caption: **Figure 1. The Find My network.** The tag whispers. A passing iPhone hears it and sends its own location, sealed. Only your devices can open it.
figures.alt: Figure 1. The Find My network. The tag whispers. A passing iPhone hears it and sends its own location, sealed. Only your devices can open it.

figures.caption: **Figure 2. The tag keeps changing its name.** Its radio ID changes every few minutes, so nobody can follow it by listening.
figures.alt: Figure 2. The tag keeps changing its name. Its radio ID changes every few minutes, so nobody can follow it by listening.

figures.caption: **Figure 3. Your dot is the finder's location.** The tag has no GPS and no Wi-Fi. The phone that heard it knows where it is, and that becomes your dot.
figures.alt: Figure 3. Your dot is the finder's location. The tag has no GPS and no Wi-Fi. The phone that heard it knows where it is, and that becomes your dot.

figures.caption: **Figure 4. Three radios, three jobs.** The farther away the tag is, the rougher the answer. Not to scale.
figures.alt: Figure 4. Three radios, three jobs. The farther away the tag is, the rougher the answer. Not to scale.

figures.caption: **Figure 5. The four parts of the app:** People, Devices, Items and Me. A simple drawing, not a screenshot.
figures.alt: Figure 5. The four parts of the app: People, Devices, Items and Me. A simple drawing, not a screenshot.

figures.caption: **Figure 6. Three ways to stay in charge of sharing.** Pause hides you from one person, Check In tells a friend only if you're late, and one tag can be shared with the family.
figures.alt: Figure 6. Three ways to stay in charge of sharing. Pause hides you from one person, Check In tells a friend only if you're late, and one tag can be shared with the family.

figures.caption: **Figure 7. Still findable.** With a signal, your phone reports itself. With a flat battery or switched off, it can still be found for a while through the Find My network.
figures.alt: Figure 7. Still findable. With a signal, your phone reports itself. With a flat battery or switched off, it can still be found for a while through the Find My network.

figures.caption: **Figure 8. If your bag doesn't arrive.** Check the map, file the airline's report, then share the link. Showing your contact info is a separate switch.
figures.alt: Figure 8. If your bag doesn't arrive. Check the map, file the airline's report, then share the link. Showing your contact info is a separate switch.

figures.caption: **Figure 9. Before you fly.** Hide the tag inside the bag, and turn off its left-behind alert (Notify When Left Behind). Left: do this. Right: not this.
figures.alt: Figure 9. Before you fly. Hide the tag inside the bag, and turn off its left-behind alert (Notify When Left Behind). Left: do this. Right: not this.

figures.caption: **Figure 10. What to do if you get an alert.** Find it, identify it, and if you feel unsafe, go somewhere public and call the police first.
figures.alt: Figure 10. What to do if you get an alert. Find it, identify it, and if you feel unsafe, go somewhere public and call the police first.

figures.caption: **Figure 11. Both phones warn you. Only Android can also scan.** An iPhone warns you on its own, but has no button to search the room on demand.
figures.alt: Figure 11. Both phones warn you. Only Android can also scan. An iPhone warns you on its own, but has no button to search the room on demand.
